notes: §1985:XIII.4.5.4 GR13: for files on a multiple file reel, a) 'Not more than one of the files may be in the open mode at one time', b) the position-number order for OUTPUT, c) 'Each of the files must be a sequential file'. The reel is hardware dependent (§1985:I.1.5.2.5.1); ScreenMultipleFileClause records it in FileModel.MultipleFileReel and CheckOpenModeForFile refuses a non-sequential member at OPEN (COBOL6816); a and b are the null facility docs/CONFORMANCE.md 3.4 determines (kb/Work PB5086), the 1985 text giving no result for a violation. Probes at 85: a RELATIVE member gives COBOL6816 (and COBOL2604); OPEN EXTEND of a member gives COBOL6814; position 2 opened before position 1 and both open together run 00 into separate host files. Witness opens them in turn.

next.reason: 1985: "Whenever a set of files resides on a multiple file reel ... Not more than one of the files may be in the open mode at one time."; 2023: "No OPEN general rule (14.9.27.4 GR 1-26) addresses multiple file reels or position numbers; the multiple file reel feature is absent.". The 2023 OPEN general rules, which hold this rule's subject, never mention multiple file reels or position numbers. No candidate carries the rule, so the 2023 standard drops it.
